parsed.draft_response:
Thank you for reporting this and for flagging it as confidential. Based on what you’ve described, your observation could indicate potential cross-tenant access when report URLs are forwarded—however, since you haven’t confirmed data exfiltration, we want to validate the behavior carefully.

We’re escalating this to our Security team for investigation. In the meantime, to help them assess impact and reproduce the issue, could you please share the following minimum details?
1) Product/platform and the specific feature creating the report link (e.g., “report sharing” / “embedded report” / “saved report link”).
2) Whether the redirected/forwarded link becomes viewable when a different user signs in—if so, what authentication/account context you used.
3) What you see in the receiving workspace: does it display the other workspace’s report contents, only the link/report shell, or something else? Is it read-only?
4) Any example URL format (you can redact tokens/secrets), and the steps to reproduce (including approximate time/date and any affected workspaces/users).
5) Whether you can provide audit/access logs or screenshots that show the receiving workspace accessing something created in the other workspace.

If sharing URLs is sensitive, you may redact identifying information and any credentials; providing the relevant parameters/structure (without secrets) is still helpful.

Once we have the above, our Security team will review the evidence and follow up with what they find and the recommended next steps.
promised_actions: Escalate the report to the Security team for investigation
Review the additional details/logs you provide to assess the behavior and potential impact
safety_notes: Do not confirm cross-tenant exposure or exfiltration until investigation completes
Avoid promising a fix, refund, or specific SLA; only state escalation and follow-up

Whether access is read-only or allows any other actions (download/export/edit).
How often this occurs and whether it is reproducible (steps to reproduce, affected environments).
Evidence or logs demonstrating cross-tenant visibility (audit logs, access logs, timestamps, example URLs).
Scope of impact (how many tenants/workspaces and users could be affected).
